input.answer: If I have to choose, I'd go with Harel (הראל), the "כספי (שקלי)" track: it says 0% מניות and 0% מט"ח, the fee is 0.57% with 0% on deposits, and it shows a steady 4.25% over 3 years and 3.08% over 5. It looks closest to a deposit, and Harel is a name I know. But I won't sign anything until I've asked you, or the bank, whether that's more than my deposits give and what "כספי" really means.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of track buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: Too many buttons with words I don't know, like 'S&P 500', 'עוקב מדד', 'כספי (שקלי)' and 'גמיש'. Nothing says 'safe' or 'like a deposit', so I didn't know where to start and pressed nothing.

stuck.where: Return column on the safe-looking tracks (אג"ח סחיר, עוקב מדדי אג"ח)
stuck.why: Instead of a number it says 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so I couldn't tell whether the bond tracks earn anything. That pushed me toward כספי (שקלי), the one with numbers.

stuck.where: The table as a whole, from screen 2 on
stuck.why: A black page with rows and rows of percentages. I lost my place in the middle of lines, and by screen 6 I was tired and stopped.
The page never compares it to a bank deposit, so I can't tell whether it beats what I have.
